title: Maximum Gap
description: Find the maximum difference between two successive elements in a sorted array using linear time.
pseudocode:
1. Find min and max values in the array
2. Calculate bucket size and count
3. Distribute elements into buckets
4. Track max gap between bucket boundaries

steps.note: Find min and max to determine range. Input: [3, 6, 9, 1]
Range is 9 - 1 = 8. With 4 elements, bucket size = ceil(8 / 3) = 3.
Assign values to buckets: B0:[1], B1:[3], B2:[6], B3:[9]
Calculate gaps between non-empty buckets: 3-1=2, 6-3=3, 9-6=3. Max gap is 3.
